description.p: BetterBanana is a virtual mixing console for PipeWire, modelled on Voicemeeter Banana. Five input strips - three hardware, two virtual - feed a 5x5 routing matrix into five buses, three hardware and two virtual, so any input can be sent to any combination of outputs at once: your voice to a chat application and to your headphones, your game to the speakers and to a stream, each with its own level.
The mixing runs in a separate engine process. Closing the window, or restarting it after an update, does not interrupt the audio.

ul.li: Gate, compressor, limiter, three-band EQ, Intellipan and fader
A twelve-band parametric EQ with shelves, pass filters and a preamp, on every strip and every bus, drawn as a draggable curve over a live spectrum analyser
A voice changer with independent pitch and formant shifting, drive, ring modulation, bit crush, chorus, echo and pitch correction
Sidechain ducking, so music steps back while you talk
Per-application routing that survives the application restarting
Headphone corrections for around 8850 models from the AutoEq database, searchable by name
Three standalone virtual cables, a recorder, an 8x8 VBAN network audio bridge, presets, undo and redo, and ten colour themes
A calibration wizard that records your voice, measures its pitch, works out the shift and plays it back so you can judge it

description.p: BetterBanana is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with VB-Audio.

description.p: A production pass over the interface: one spacing, radius and type scale throughout, a colour contract that keeps every foreground readable in all ten themes, and meters that share a single dB-per- pixel so the same level is the same height in every column.
